suite_note: CEC'2017 bound-constrained: 51 runs, MaxFES = 10000*D, D in {10,30,50,100}, errors below 1e-8 reported as 0. F2 excluded (withdrawn as unstable), leaving F1 and F3..F30.
seed_scheme: algorithm rng = default_rng([SEED_BASE, dim, run, algorithm_seed(name)]), algorithm_seed = blake2b-8(name) mod (2**31-1); noise rng = default_rng([NOISE_SEED, dim, run]) (matched across algorithms). Version 1 used the algorithm's index in sorted(ALL_ALGORITHMS), which re-seeded every algorithm whenever the line-up changed; results recorded under version 1 are NOT resumable here.

sharded.note: run split across CI jobs by function; seeds contain no function or shard term, so this is identical to a single-process run
